reason: The analyst omitted the key pre-period confounder productivity_2020 (and the other 2020 covariates), and used an unjustified 1% outcome trim, so the 0.954 estimate is overstated compared with the fully adjusted 0.84 (CI about 0.37 to 1.31). The report also gives no discussion of confounding or robustness and shows only one specification. The positive direction holds, but the estimate and conclusion are not adequately supported for release.
